title: Genomic Sequencing Lab Operations
thesis: Snowflake turns daily instrument activity from Harbourline Genomics, a synthetic Singapore research sequencing network with 8 lab sites from Queenstown to Changi, into yield and QC-flag-precision KPIs, 7-day failed-run risk scores, phasing anomalies and grounded AI answers, all on curated dynamic tables, with aggregate data only and no patient or genomic records.

talking_points: Yield attainment, samples sequenced, data output and QC flag precision for 40 sequencers across 8 Singapore lab sites and 5 assays.
Every KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so it can be traced back to instrument-day rows.
The failure-mode chart shows which QC flags lead to confirmed failed runs and which mostly pass on review.
tabs.call_out: One governed set of lab operations KPIs, traceable to source rows

transition.line: Which sequencers should the QC team look at first?

talking_points: Snowflake ML classification scores each sequencer's probability of a confirmed failed run in the next 7 days.
The holdout line shows precision and recall on the most recent 14 days, against the base rate.
Anomaly detection flags phasing outliers per sequencer, and the forecast projects network-wide sample volume for 14 days.
tabs.call_out: Honest, evaluated ML inside the data platform

talking_points: Preventive maintenance compliance, reagent kit coverage and kits on order frame the readiness gaps.
PM compliance against confirmed failed runs by sequencer shows where missed maintenance and failures move together; it is an association, not proof of cause.
The action memo drafts three prioritised actions from the KPI, sequencer, failure-mode and risk tables only.
tabs.call_out: Grounded draft actions, with a human in the loop

transition.line: What happens when a run finishes with a QC flag right now?

talking_points: Run-completion summaries land in RAW.LIVE_RUNS, from the simulator or from S3 uploads through Snowpipe.
The Snowflake alert logs QC_FLAG events with an SOP hint and the sequencer's current risk band, then emails the QC scientist.
tabs.call_out: From run completion to QC action in one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent uses Cortex Analyst over the semantic view for metrics, and Cortex Search over synthetic run QC troubleshooting SOPs.
Each answer shows the generated SQL and the SOPs it cited.

transition.line: Here is how it is built.

talking_points: Two builds share one core: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake (S3 run-summary uploads, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q).
Everything shown is synthetic, aggregate demo data, rebuilt reproducibly from the repo.
tabs.call_out: One governed core, with an optional AWS edge
